result.title: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
result.comment: Published as conference proceeding for NeurIPS 2026. Last two authors advised equally
result.summary: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) achieve remarkable success on diverse multimodal understanding and generation tasks, yet they still struggle to effectively leverage language-based chain-of-thought reasoning for image generation. As a result, existing reasoning-augmented UMMs often fail to inherit the test-time scaling and fine-grained controllability observed in large language models. We attribute this failure to a fundamental modality mismatch: reasoning is performed in a discrete token space, whereas image generation operates in a continuous space. To bridge this gap, we introduce a Latent Reasoning framework in Continuous space (LARC), which alleviates the token-level bottleneck by reasoning over continuous hidden states. Specifically, the training framework consists of two stages: (i) curriculum supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and (ii) information-gain reinforcement learning (RL). First, the curriculum SFT stage gradually converts token-level reasoning into latent reasoning. Subsequently, the information-gain RL stage self-evolves latent reasoning without ground truth supervision. Experiments across diverse text-to-image generation benchmarks show that LARC consistently improves generation quality, prompt following, and compositional fidelity. Notably, LARC achieves state-of-the-art performance on GenEval with a 7%p gain over BAGEL and demonstrates clear test-time scaling behavior, outperforming token-based generation under both parallel and sequential test-time scaling strategies.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LARC，在统一多模态模型的连续隐状态空间中替代离散 token 链式推理：先用课程式 SFT 把 token 级推理逐步转为 latent 推理，再用信息增益 RL 无监督自演化；在文生图基准上提升生成质量、提示跟随与组合保真度，GenEval 较 BAGEL 提升 7%p，并呈现并行与顺序两种测试时扩展行为。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 在「连续 latent 状态取代离散推理轨迹」「课程式监督到 RL 的训练分配」「测试时扩展」上直接同构，可供对照；但其目标是图像生成，latent 状态是否承载可核验的视觉证据与关系、以及 latent 轨迹本身是否可读仍需核查。
